Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.buildings.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Card, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
EndGameBuildingCard, ModifierBuildingCard, ObserverPairBuildingCard, ObserverSetBuildingCard
public abstract class BuildingCard extends Object implements Card
Represents the abstract base class for all building cards in the game. It encapsulates the common attributes such as era, food cost, and base prestige gain.
